scope: Conditional sampled recommended-assembly usage/service study; not physical proof
fallback: If no replacement shell manifest, source shells + explicit continuous collars are both checked; this is not a claim that their mesh union was verified.

assumptions.pull: 0..60mm illustrative annular conical film, central translating clamp; bandradius1.5mm and midpointjunction assumed
assumptions.sampling: Rigidtools are cylinders sampled angularly/axially, not complete swept-volume boolean proof; negative clearances identify sampled intersections.
